  // START KEVIN CAA WIZARD SECTION KtCourseGuardQt QT UPDATE DIALOG

  // clang-format off

  // 1, Selected_Spec, field widget
  KT_AUTO_FIELD_SET_LINE(ui->listWidgetSelectedSpec, parameter->Selected_Spec);

  // 2, Axis_Vector, Qt vector
  dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorX->setValue(parameter->Axis_Vector.GetX() * 0.001);
  dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorY->setValue(parameter->Axis_Vector.GetY() * 0.001);
  dialogMore->doubleSpinBoxAxisVectorZ->setValue(parameter->Axis_Vector.GetZ() * 0.001);

  // 3, Float_Values, legacy asymmetric listData type is not suitable for auto code.

  // 4, Count, round to integer
  ui->doubleSpinBoxCount->setValue(parameter->Count);

  // 5, Number, integer spinner
  ui->spinBoxNumber->setValue(parameter->Number);

  // 6, Flags, bit flags
  ui->checkBoxFlags0->setChecked( parameter->Flags & (1<<0));
  ui->checkBoxFlags1->setChecked( parameter->Flags & (1<<1));

  // 7, Mode, enum radio
  if (parameter->Mode>1 || parameter->Mode<0) parameter->Mode=0;//Correct
  ui->radioButtonMode0->setChecked( parameter->Mode==0);
  ui->radioButtonMode1->setChecked( parameter->Mode==1);

  // 8, Index, integer combo
  ui->comboBoxIndex->setCurrentIndex(parameter->Index);

  // 9, Title, Qt string combo
  ui->comboBoxTitle->setEditText(parameter->Title);

  // 10, Kt_Name, legacy placeholder
  ui->comboBoxKtName->setEditText(QString::fromLocal8Bit({strParamSame}.str()));

  // 11, Text_Value, local string conversion
  dialogMore->lineEditTextValue->setText(  QString::fromLocal8Bit(parameter->Text_Value.str()) );

  // 12, No_Action, zero controls,NO ACTION, QSpinBox,0

  // 13, Unsupported, unknown Qt control,NO ACTION, QDial (Not Support),1

  // 14, Plain_Text, Qt text
  ui->lineEditPlainText->setText( parameter->Plain_Text);

  // 15, Text_List, legacy string list
  ui->lineEditTextList0->setText( QString::fromLocal8Bit(parameter->Text_List.str()) [1]);
  ui->lineEditTextList1->setText( QString::fromLocal8Bit(parameter->Text_List.str()) [2]);

  // 16, Numbers, integer list
  ui->spinBoxNumbers0->setValue(parameter->Numbers[0]);
  ui->spinBoxNumbers1->setValue(parameter->Numbers[1]);

  // 17, Enabled, single checkbox
  ui->checkBoxEnabled->setChecked(parameter->Enabled);

  // 18, Push, directional no action,NO ACTION, QPushButton,1

  // clang-format on
  // END KEVIN CAA WIZARD SECTION KtCourseGuardQt QT UPDATE DIALOG
